source.prompt: Wide 16:9 interior of a cozy old Russian log-built tavern kitchen at night, straight-on view from the guests' side at eye level. CENTRE: a long carved wooden guest counter with four simple empty round wooden stools in front of it, two candles and an oil lamp on the counter. RIGHT third: a calm, plain log wall with three empty wooden wall shelves, uncluttered and visually quiet.
